info.name: Twilio SendGrid Provisioning Account Teammates API

params.name: limit
params.description: `limit` sets the page size, i.e. maximum number of items from the list to be returned for a single API request. If omitted, the default page size is used. The maximum page size for this endpoint is 500 items per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items in the list to skip over before starting to retrieve the items for the requested page. The default `offset` of `0` represents the beginning of the list, i.e. the start of the first page. To request the second page of the list, set the `offset` to the page size as determined by `limit`. Use multiples of the page size as your `offset` to request further consecutive pages. E.g. assume your page size is set to `10`. An `offset` of `10` requests the second page, an `offset` of `20` requests the third page and so on, provided there are sufficiently many items in your list.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to retrieve a paginated list of all current Teammates.**

You can use the `limit` query parameter to set the page size. If your list contains more items than the page size permits, you can make multiple requests. Use the `offset` query parameter to control the position in the list from which to start retrieving additional items.

**This endpoint allows you to invite a Teammate to your account via email.**

You can set a Teammate's initial permissions using the `scopes` array in the request body. Teammate's will receive a minimum set of scopes from Twilio SendGrid that are necessary for the Teammate to function.

**Note:** A teammate invite will expire after 7 days, but you may resend the invitation at any time to reset the expiration date.

params.name: teammate_name
params.description: The username of the Teammate for whom you want to retrieve Subuser access information.

params.name: after_subuser_id
params.description: The Subuser ID from which the API request will begin retrieving Subusers. This query parameter can be used in successive API calls to retrieve additional Subusers.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of Subusers to be returned. The default `limit` is `100` per request.

params.name: username
params.description: A Subuser's username that will be used to filter the returned result.

items.docs:
**This operation allows you to retrieve the Subusers that can be accessed by a specified Teammate.**

This operation will return the Subusers available to a Teammate, including the scopes available. If the Teammate is an administrator, all Subusers will be returned.

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the teammate that you want to retrieve.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to retrieve a specific Teammate by username.**

You can retrieve the username's for each of your Teammates using the "Retrieve all Teammates" endpoint.

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the teammate that you want to retrieve.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to update a teammate’s permissions.**

To turn a teammate into an admin, the request body should contain an `is_admin` set to `true`. Otherwise, set `is_admin` to `false` and pass in all the scopes that a teammate should have.

**Only the parent user or other admin teammates can update another teammate’s permissions.**

**Admin users can only update permissions.**

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the teammate that you want to retrieve.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to delete a teammate.**

**Only the parent user or an admin teammate can delete another teammate.**

**This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of all pending Teammate invitations.**

Each teammate invitation is valid for 7 days. Users may resend the invitation to refresh the expiration date.

params.name: token
params.description: The token for the invite you want to delete.

items.docs: **This endpoint allows you to delete a pending teammate invite.**

params.name: token
params.description: The token for the invite that you want to resend.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to resend a Teammate invitation.**

Teammate invitations will expire after 7 days. Resending an invitation will reset the expiration date.
